clinicalPearls: Hoarseness over 3 weeks in smoker: scope larynx
Glottic early and node sparing; supraglottic nodal and bilateral neck
Chemoradiation preserves organ, salvage laryngectomy rescues failure
reference.pathophysiology: Tobacco field change plus reflux and alcohol synergise squamous carcinogenesis on vibratory cord epithelium, while subsite lymphatic density and cartilage barriers channel spread patterns exploited by staging.
additionalDifferentials: Glottic versus supraglottic by nodes and timing
Laryngeal cancer versus chronic laryngitis (biopsy persistence)
Organ preservation versus laryngectomy by function, not anatomy alone
additionalInvestigations: Laryngoscopy biopsy and stroboscopy, CT or MRI neck
Chest CT for second primary in smokers
Speech swallow, nutrition and thyroid baseline
